name: Fabric Tube Rendering
definition: An approach to interpret the fabric structure as streamtubes on the surface without creating actual tubes. It uses binormals derived from eigenvectors and image-plane normals to determine tube position and width, creating a tube-like effect with proper spatial impression.
summary: Fabric Tube Rendering is a post-processing technique that creates a fabric-like spatial impression on surfaces by interpreting tensor fields as streamtubes in image space, avoiding explicit 3D geometry construction.
